messages:
Mika: Heads up — after today's private deploy a couple customers reported they can't reach the private control-plane admin UI. Investigating now, might be tied to last week's RBAC refactor. @Tom @Harper can you take a look?
Tom: On it. Saw a spike of 500s from control-plane-auth around 11:00 UTC.
Harper: I grabbed logs for acme-inc and saw repeated KMS errors: `KMS: AccessDenied` on decrypt calls starting 11:02 UTC.
Mika: If KMS decrypts fail, session tokens wouldn't be created — that would drop admin sessions. Which change touched service account names/roles?
Tom: The refactor introduced `admin-proxy-sa` and renamed the old `admin` role to `controlplane-admin`. Deployment script should have applied IAM bindings but I think the KMS binding step lives in a separate provisioner job that might have skipped.
Harper: audit-bot shows `auth:permission_denied` events for `controlplane-admin` hitting KMS at 11:02 UTC.
audit-bot: audit: 1768001305 auth:permission_denied principal=admin-proxy-sa resource=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/pp/cryptoKeys/controlplane-key
Irene: I also noticed the network ACL for the private control-plane LB was tightened to 10.0.0.0/16 during the same change window. Several customer subnets are in 10.1.0.0/16 so their KMS requests from those IPs were dropped earlier this morning.
Mika: Ok two vectors: missing KMS IAM binding for new SA, and network ACL blocking some customer KMS traffic. We should fix IAM binding first (least risky). Harper can you prepare the minimal IAM grant? Scope it to the key resource: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the specific cryptoKey.
Harper: Yep. Patch ready — will apply grant for `serviceAccount:admin-proxy-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` scoped to `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/pp/cryptoKeys/controlplane-key`. Will PR the infra change with justification.
Tom: I'll coordinate a deploy window. Also we should rollback the role rename doc or at least ensure our tooling maps old->new so we don't miss bindings.
Irene: I'll relax the LB ACL to include 10.1.0.0/16 for the short term, but will add a narrower rule: allow only KMS endpoints for those subnets. Don't want to leave broad access.
Samir: We need a prevention ticket: add CI check that verifies for every deploy that any new service accounts mentioned in Terraform have explicit KMS bindings when they touch control-plane functions. Filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2143 :eyes:
Mika: Good. Also add an alert for repeated `KMS:AccessDenied` spikes tied to control-plane auth; we missed that threshold today.
Harper: Hotfix applied at 11:28 UTC — KMS binding created. Confirmed decrypts succeeding in logs.
Irene: LB ACL updated at 11:34 UTC to include 10.1.0.0/16 for KMS port 443 -> traffic seeing 200 now.
Tom: Admin UI reachable for impacted tenants per synthetic checks. Rolling monitor for 30m. :thumbsup:
Samir: I'm drafting a short postmortem with root cause (role rename + provisioning gap + ACL tighten) + remediation (CI check, deploy script idempotency, scoped IAM template). Will share once draft ready.
Mika: Thanks team. Quick action prevented longer outage. Follow up: put KMS binding step into the main provisioning pipeline and add an integration test that mirrors a private deploy.
Harper: Agreed. I'll add test and PR the infra change tomorrow.
Irene: I'll include the ACL change in the change-log and notify infra customers.
Tom: Closing on-call for this incident, monitoring stable.
Mika: Closing thread — will sync on postmortem doc tomorrow.
